body.heading: How is a tattoo removed by laser?
paragraphs: We remove tattoos using our advanced YAG laser. This is one of the best-known and most reliable lasers in the field of removing pigment from the skin. Because the YAG laser reaches deeper than other lasers, it can also very effectively remove poorly placed tattoos (placed too deep in the skin) that have started to migrate.

The YAG laser, also known as the Q-Switched laser, is generally regarded as the gold standard for removing tattoos and permanent make-up. By generating enormous pulses, a unique laser-tissue interaction occurs in the skin. The pigment is encapsulated into small particles, so that it disappears from the skin more quickly.

body.heading: What does a tattoo laser treatment look like?
paragraphs: The unwanted tattoo is removed within a very short time by means of laser. It takes only a few seconds to treat a small area of the tattoo with the laser.
During a consultation we determine roughly how many treatments will be needed, which package suits you best and what the aftercare involves. After that we schedule all the sessions.

body.heading: How many sessions are needed to laser off a tattoo?
paragraphs: Every old and unwanted tattoo is different. That is why we cannot say in advance how many treatments are needed on average to laser off the old tattoo. During a consultation we look at the unwanted tattoo, assess the condition of the skin and determine the size of the tattoo. We discuss your wishes, clearly explain the aftercare and then draw up a treatment plan.

This way you know exactly how many sessions will be needed and how much rest time there is between each treatment. In addition to individual sessions, we also offer packages. A package is more economical than booking individual treatments again after every laser session. Of course, both options are possible with us.

body.heading: How do you prepare for a tattoo laser treatment?
paragraphs: Below we discuss the steps you are best to follow once you have scheduled a laser treatment. We ask you to adhere very strictly to the rules below, as they negatively affect how the laser works.

1 week before the treatment you may no longer use a tanning bed. It is also better not to have peels or microneedling if the tattoo is on the face. Within 24 hours before the treatment it is very important that you do not take any alcohol, painkillers, drugs or blood-thinning medication. paragraphs: To create the perfect permanent make-up eyeliner, a subtle, thin line is applied just above the lash line using (semi-)permanent make-up. This gives a natural effect that makes your lashes appear fuller. The treatment is completely painless thanks to the use of numbing gel. This is applied before the treatment, and only once the gel has absorbed does the treatment begin.

In addition, a permanent eyeliner has a short aftercare period. The PMU machine leaves pixels of pigment in the first layer of skin. The permanent make-up machine has multiple needles in the cartridge, making it easy to create a beautiful liner. By applying the permanent make-up in the first layer of skin, you avoid:
checklist: Scars
Skin tissue from damaged skin
Difficult or longer aftercare
Swelling and redness
A painful treatment

How long the permanent make-up eyeliner actually remains visible varies from person to person and can, for example, be shorter if you have oilier skin. In addition, factors such as a lot of sun, skin peels or scrubs affect how long the Infralash remains clearly visible.

permanente-make-up-moedervlek.intro: Placing a permanent make-up beauty spot, also known as a faux freckle, is currently one of the most popular treatments. A beauty spot is one of the seven beauties. Unfortunately, not all of us are blessed with one, and so we can luckily apply it cosmetically! The treatment is painless and you enjoy the freckles for around 1 to 3 years. After that, they fade away completely. Contact us to discuss the options!

body.heading: Beauty Spot & Freckle

In addition to placing a single or a few beauty spots, IZZI Beauty also specialises in placing faux freckles on the face. Before the treatment, we always discuss your wishes in detail and pre-draw the freckle or freckles, so that you get a good impression of the final result.

body.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: A permanent make-up beauty spot gives you a natural, playful appearance without damaging your skin. The main benefits at a glance:
checklist: No damage to the skin
Lasts 1 to 3 years
No longer needing to draw them on every day
Desired colour available per skin type

body.heading: How is a beauty spot placed?
paragraphs: A 'faux freckle' is placed using semi-permanent make-up. This is done with micropigmentation: small needles apply the pigment into the first layer of skin. This causes no damage to the skin and lets you enjoy the treatment for up to about 3 years.

Before the treatment starts, we discuss carefully what we are going to do, which colours we can work with, and together we determine where the freckle will go. The treatment is painless and done fairly quickly. In addition to a single beauty spot, IZZI Beauty also places faux freckles on the face — always after discussing and pre-drawing your wishes.

body.heading: What is a permanent make-up beauty spot?
paragraphs: A 'faux freckle' is a simulated freckle placed with permanent make-up. Customers often opt for a faux freckle look, but also for a single beauty spot that is somewhat larger and sits close to the lip. Before the PMU treatment starts, we discuss your wishes and pre-draw the single freckle or freckles, so that you get a good impression of how it will ultimately look.

We work with semi-permanent make-up. This means that the beauty spot or freckles fade over time. After about 1 year, you can come back to refresh the colour again and make the beauty spot more prominent with the pigment chosen at the time.

body.heading: How long does a beauty spot treatment take?
paragraphs: A single beauty spot treatment takes about 15 minutes, including the consultation. When only one freckle needs to be placed — which is usually slightly larger than a normal freckle — we use multiple needles. This makes it easier to create a beautiful and even freckle and is also a reason why the treatment is so short.
Of course, we first take plenty of time to determine the location and the pigment that suits your skin type well. Feel free to contact us to discuss the options.

body.heading: How long does a PMU beauty spot last?
paragraphs: A 'faux freckle' with permanent make-up lasts about 1 to 3 years. However, how long the permanent make-up lasts strongly depends on factors such as sun damage and any peels or microneedling treatments you have in the meantime. Sun damage in particular causes the pigment in the skin to fade.

The advice is therefore to have the freckle touched up slightly with pigment again after about 1 year. This way, another layer of pigment is placed over it, so the freckle lasts longer and you enjoy it for even longer.

paragraphs: Faux Freckles are freckles applied to your skin with permanent make-up. The tattooed freckles look so natural that you can barely tell them apart from real freckles! Exactly how long they last depends on factors such as your skin type, lifestyle and how well you care for them — on average you enjoy them for 1 to 3 years.

Beforehand, we draw the freckles on your face with a pencil so you can see how it will look. Only once you are completely satisfied do we choose a colour together that suits your wishes and skin tone. Each freckle is placed in a playful way; they are not all the same size, round or evenly spaced, so it looks completely natural.
Faux Freckles are perfect if you want a subtle, natural look with sun-kissed freckles! Feel free to contact us on 06 – 11 76 88 81 to discuss the options.

body.heading: Benefits of Faux Freckles
paragraphs: Faux Freckles give you a playful, summery appearance without damaging your skin. The main benefits at a glance:
checklist: Natural-looking, made-to-measure freckles
Virtually painless treatment
No damage to the skin
1 to 3 years of enjoying your freckles
Summery, sun-kissed freckles permanently present
Semi-permanent and fully tailored to your wishes

body.heading: How Are Faux Freckles Placed?
paragraphs: These semi-permanent freckles are applied using a special micropigmentation technique. The pigment is carefully placed into the upper layer of skin, which creates a subtle and natural appearance. The treatment itself is virtually painless.

At IZZI Beauty we work as experts in the field of Faux Freckles and make sure the result perfectly suits your face and wishes. Before we begin, we discuss your preferences in detail and first draw the freckles on your face with a pencil. This way you can clearly see beforehand what the final result will look like.

To achieve the most natural effect possible, we pay extra attention to detail. The freckles we place are not all perfectly round, have different shades and are spread in a playful way. Only after you are completely satisfied with the placement and colour of the pigment do we start the treatment.

body.heading: How Long Do Permanent Make-Up Freckles Last?
paragraphs: Permanent make-up freckles remain visible for an average of 1 to 3 years. How long your Faux Freckles last largely depends on how you care for your skin. Factors such as sun exposure, regular peels or treatments such as microneedling can shorten their lifespan, as these affect the upper layer of skin where the pigment is applied.

Because the freckle tattoo is applied into the first layer of skin — which is naturally sensitive to external influences — its lifespan can be affected. That is why it is important to protect your skin well if you want to enjoy your freckles for as long as possible.

The intensity of your Faux Freckles also plays a role. Are you opting for subtle, sun-kissed freckles? These light, summery freckles are super natural and resemble the freckles you get from the sun. Or would you rather go for somewhat darker freckles that stand out more and have a deeper pigment? Both options are possible and are fully tailored to your wishes. Before, but also during the treatment, we discuss your preferences together, so you always leave with a look that suits you perfectly.

body.heading: What Do Faux Freckles Look Like Once Healed?
paragraphs: After the treatment, your freckles look natural and soft very quickly. The healing process of the freckle tattoo is one of the fastest of all permanent make-up treatments. Within 4 to 6 days, the freckles and the desired colour are already clearly visible. The skin, however, needs 30 to 40 days to heal completely.

To achieve the best result, it is important to follow the aftercare properly. After the treatment, you receive an e-mail from us with detailed aftercare instructions, and we explain the aftercare verbally. Take good care of your skin during this period so you can enjoy your new, natural Faux Freckles to the fullest!

body.heading: What is a Touch Up treatment for Powder Brows?
paragraphs: Ombré Powder Brows is one of the most popular semi-permanent make-up treatments: we create natural, full eyebrows with a soft powder effect. However, even the most beautiful eyebrows need maintenance over time — and that is exactly what a touch-up is for.

A touch-up is less intensive than the original Powder Brows treatment and usually takes 60 to 90 minutes. The pigment is refreshed, the contours are made crisper, and the colour regains a fresh, even shade.

Less intensive than the first treatment
Usually takes 60 to 90 minutes

It has been 1.5 to 2 years since your eyebrows were treated

body.heading: Benefits of a Touch Up

combi-brows-behandeling.intro: The combi brows treatment is the solution for anyone who dreams of full, natural eyebrows without daily use of make-up. This popular technique combines the best of hairstrokes and ombré powder brows into a subtle, crisp look that perfectly suits your face.

body.heading: Combi eyebrows by IZZI Beauty
paragraphs: Unlike many other providers, we do not use microblading. In our treatment, the fine hairstrokes at the front of the eyebrows are placed with an advanced PMU machine. This not only creates a natural effect, but also prevents the possible skin damage that can occur with microblading. The rest of the eyebrows are subtly filled in with a soft shading technique, creating a defined and well-groomed look.

This semi-permanent make-up treatment is ideal for people who want to save time every day, correct bald spots or asymmetry, or simply always want perfect eyebrows. With a lifespan of up to 3 to 4 years — depending on your skin type, aftercare and a touch-up after about 2 years — this is an investment in long-lasting beauty. The treatment is virtually painless and is fully tailored to your wishes.
checklist: No microblading, but a skin-friendly technique with a PMU machine
Always well-groomed and symmetrical eyebrows
Corrects bald spots, scars and asymmetry
The perfect balance between a natural and defined look

body.heading: What are Combi Brows?
paragraphs: Combi brows is a semi-permanent make-up technique that combines hairstrokes with a powdery effect. The hairstrokes create a natural start at the front of the eyebrows, while the powder effect subtly fills in the rest of the eyebrows. This gives a well-groomed, symmetrical and soft appearance that is fully tailored to your face shape.

With combi brows, a PMU machine is used, which is less demanding on the skin than microblading. Thanks to this technique, an even colour transition from light to dark is created, resulting in natural-looking eyebrows that are perfectly balanced. Whether you want to keep full eyebrows, correct asymmetry or camouflage empty spots — combi brows offer a solution.

body.heading: Who are combi brows suitable for?
paragraphs: Combi brows are a great solution for people who always want to enjoy perfect, natural eyebrows without daily use of make-up. This technique is ideal for:
checklist: People with asymmetrical eyebrows who want a balanced shape
Anyone who wants to fill in bald spots, for example due to excessive plucking or hair loss
People with scars in or around the eyebrows
People with thin or uneven hair growth who want fuller eyebrows
Those who want to save time each day on drawing in their eyebrows
People with conditions such as alopecia that lead to partial or complete hair loss

body.heading: Benefits of Combi Brows
paragraphs: This treatment offers several benefits that make your eyebrows not only more beautiful, but also more practical:
checklist: Natural appearance: the combination of hairstrokes and a soft shading technique creates well-groomed eyebrows without a 'drawn-on' look
Long-lasting result: with good aftercare, combi brows stay beautiful for up to 4 years; a touch-up after 1.5 to 2 years keeps them fresh
Save time: no more daily make-up needed — your eyebrows are always on point
Corrects imperfections: ideal for bald spots, scars or asymmetry
Skin-friendly: the PMU machine is less demanding on the skin and prevents scar formation
Versatile: tailored to your face shape and suitable for most skin types

body.heading: Preparing for a Combi Brows Treatment
paragraphs: Good preparation ensures an optimal and long-lasting result. In the days before your appointment, keep the following in mind:
checklist: Avoid blood thinners, alcohol and caffeine on the day of the treatment
Do not come with tanned or burnt skin — avoid the sun and the tanning bed
Do not pluck or tint your eyebrows just before the appointment
Stop in good time with skincare containing retinol or fruit acids around the eyebrows
Bring any reference images so we can determine the desired shape together

body.heading: Aftercare after a Combi Brows Treatment
paragraphs: Immediately after the treatment: your eyebrows may look somewhat darker and fuller for the first few days, and slight redness may occur. If necessary, gently dab them dry and apply only the aftercare cream provided.

The first 7 days: keep the eyebrows dry for the first 72 hours and avoid make-up, creams, direct sunlight, saunas and swimming pools. Let any scabs come off on their own and do not scratch them, so the pigment adheres nicely and evenly.

The first 30 days: protect your eyebrows against bright sun and use an SPF cream after healing. Around day 30, the colour has fully settled to the definitive, natural shade. A free touch-up after 6 to 8 weeks perfects the final result.

Use only the aftercare cream you received from the specialist
Avoid make-up, sunlight, sauna and swimming pool in the first 7 days
Let scabs come off naturally — do not scratch or pick
Schedule the free touch-up after 6 to 8 weeks

hero.title: Permanent Make-Up Colour Correction
hero.text: In a colour correction treatment, old permanent make-up that has discoloured into an unwanted colour such as grey, red, purple or blue is corrected to a fresh, neutral and soft brown shade.

kleurcorrectie.intro: A PMU colour correction treatment is a treatment in which old permanent make-up that has discoloured into an unwanted colour — think grey, red, purple or blue — is corrected. This PMU treatment is the same kind of treatment as pigmentation in the first layer of skin, as with Powder Brows, only different types of colours are usually used. It is a painless treatment in which the healing process takes about 30 days. The aim is for the old colour and the new colour to blend together in the skin, so that a beautiful, soft brown colour emerges after healing.

body.heading: Colour Correction Permanent Make-Up
paragraphs: Before the treatment starts, we discuss carefully with you what a colour correction is, how we can correct your eyebrows, how many treatments we expect to need, what the recovery process involves and what you can expect. This way you know exactly where you stand beforehand and we work together towards the desired result.
Feel free to contact us to discuss the options for your situation. Based on a clear photo, we can often already estimate well how many treatments are needed and which colour is best to use.

body.heading: Benefits of a colour correction
paragraphs: For many people, a colour correction is the ideal solution to make discoloured permanent make-up fresh and natural again. The main benefits at a glance:
checklist: Suitable for every skin type
Painless treatment with fast healing
Fresh, natural eyebrow colour
No redness or swelling
Unwanted discolouration is neutralised
No bald spots or scars
About 1.5 years of enjoying the colour correction

body.heading: When can a colour correction be carried out?
paragraphs: A colour correction of old permanent make-up can be carried out when the eyebrows have discoloured into an unwanted colour. This is often because pigment was placed too deeply and scar tissue has formed in the skin. We often see this after a Microblading treatment, because there pigment is placed in the third layer of skin instead of the first layer as with powder brows.

We see red or grey eyebrows come by every day. Grey eyebrows are often the result of working too deep with the needle, while red often remains because it is the last colour to disappear — literally the last remnant of the old permanent make-up.

Depending on how saturated and possibly damaged the skin is, we look at how many treatments will be needed. We can often already determine this well based on a clear photo. Most customers only need 1 colour correction treatment; if several sessions are needed, we base the price on that.

body.heading: The colour correction treatment
paragraphs: A colour correction is carried out in the same way as powder brows, only different types of colours are used. With a colour opposite to the discoloured permanent make-up, we create a softer or warmer shade. The aim is for the old and the new colour to blend together in the skin, so that a beautiful, soft brown colour emerges after healing.

The treatment is done by means of micropigmentation, exactly as with placing powder brows. It is experienced as not painful and is often finished within 45 minutes to an hour. The aftercare is exactly the same as for powder brows.

body.heading: Correcting permanent make-up & Powder Brows
paragraphs: IZZI Brows often corrects old permanent make-up — that is what we are known for, and we are happy to do something for everyone, if possible. It is also an option to first have a colour correction carried out on the old permanent make-up with us and then have a new Ombré Powder Brows treatment placed.

If the discoloured PMU is not too saturated, we can sometimes place a colour correction including new powder brows in 1 treatment. With only a colour correction, no new shape is applied — we purely correct the colour present within the current shape.

body.heading: How long do you have discoloured eyebrows after a colour correction?
paragraphs: Because old discoloured permanent make-up is corrected with an opposite colour, the treatment ends with a slight glow. This glow can be yellowish or greenish and of course does not look very nice, but it fades quickly. So you certainly do not leave the salon with bright yellow or bright green eyebrows.

You experience the glow for about 1 day. After that, you notice the eyebrows becoming lighter and lighter and taking on a nicer brown colour. The aftercare is exactly the same as for powder brows and the treatment is experienced as not painful.

body.heading: What does a colour correction cost?
paragraphs: The treatment to correct a colour is a good solution for many people to get the current colour back to the desired shade or simply make it softer. Depending on how many treatments are needed, we determine the price for your colour correction. Colour correction treatment prices start from €250.
If the colour correction treatment includes new Ombré Powder Brows, you receive a discount on the colour correction. For more information and advice, you can e-mail, WhatsApp or call us.

body.heading: Micro Scalp Pigmentation Treatment
paragraphs: Micro scalp pigmentation is the pigmentation of the scalp by means of semi-permanent make-up. Small pixels are applied that resemble trimmed hairs. This can be placed to fill in the hair or on the entire head, depending on your wishes and baldness. It is also possible, for example, to treat only a number of areas of the head.

Micro scalp pigmentation creates the illusion of more hair density by covering the scalp with pixels of PMU. The pigments are placed shallowly in the skin, which makes the treatment feel very mild and therefore very easy to endure.

The treatment cannot be compared to tattooing the head: tattoos are placed fairly deep in the skin, whereas with semi-permanent make-up we do this very superficially. This ensures that the pigments can never discolour. MHP can be applied from €450!

body.heading: Benefits

Natural, shaved look
More than 5 years of enjoying your new look

body.heading: What Is Micro Scalp Pigmentation?
paragraphs: MHP, or the micropigmentation of the scalp, is a treatment in which pigmentation is applied to the scalp to realistically mimic the natural look of real hair. Micro scalp pigmentation is suitable for both men and women with thinning hair.

Of course, not many women choose scalp pigmentation over the entire head, but this is also possible. Women more often choose scalp pigmentation to fill in small areas of the scalp, with the illusion that there is more hair on somewhat balder spots. Scalp pigmentation is therefore not only suitable for men but also for women.

In addition, scalp pigmentation can also be carried out on people who suffer from alopecia. Alopecia is a condition in which the hair falls out; with alopecia totalis, the hair disappears almost everywhere. Micro scalp pigmentation can then be a beautiful solution without any underlying hair follicles being damaged.
Men more often choose scalp pigmentation to give their hairline more definition optically, fill in a receding hairline or give a number of bald spots more colour so they stand out less.

body.heading: MHP for Alopecia Areata
paragraphs: Alopecia Areata, a form of patchy baldness, is caused by a disturbance of the hair roots and can occur suddenly. This can result in bald spots where the hairs fall out almost completely, while the surrounding skin shows normal hair growth.
We can completely fill in the balding spots with MHP and thus make them virtually invisible on the scalp.

body.heading: How Is Our MHP Treatment Carried Out?
paragraphs: First, we look carefully at your hair colour to ensure that the coloured pigments match exactly. The hair pigmentation is then placed by means of small pixels of colour in the skin. Because these pixels are so small, they resemble a shaved look, with stubble or short cropped hair.

The pixels are placed with semi-permanent make-up pigments that are applied into the first layer of skin. This technique ensures that, unlike with a tattoo, no scar tissue ever forms in the skin. Scalp pigmentation is a virtually painless and swift treatment.
We spread the treatment over 2 to 3 sessions. This means that we build up the colour and pixels further each time to create the most natural effect possible.

body.heading: How Long Does A Treatment Take?
paragraphs: A treatment takes an average of around 3 to 4 hours, depending on the area you have treated. We draw up a treatment plan together with you, so you know how many sessions are needed to achieve the desired result.
We often schedule 2 to 3 sessions to create a natural effect. We build up the pixels further each time. There is at least about 2 weeks between each session.

body.heading: How Long Does Scalp Pigmentation Last?
paragraphs: Micro scalp pigmentation remains visible for about 4 to 5 years. We do recommend having a touch-up treatment after 1.5 to 2 years to maintain a crisp shape and beautiful colour. Aftercare is very important with this treatment for retention of the pigment; we therefore always advise you to follow the aftercare very strictly.

The longevity also depends on sun damage and the use of scrubs on your skin. Sun damage in particular leads to a strong loss of pigment in the micro scalp pigmentation. However, the pixels fade gradually, so no bald patches suddenly become visible when pigment is lost.

body.heading: What Does A Micro Scalp Pigmentation Treatment Cost?
paragraphs: A treatment starts from €450.00 up to €2150 for a whole head. A touch-up treatment is included in the price and is carried out after 2 weeks. This puts the finishing touches in place after the recovery process of the first treatment. After a touch-up treatment, the pigment will fade by about 40%.
Unfortunately, we do not offer the option of payment instalments. You always pay for a treatment in full; on the day of the treatment, the amount must be settled before the treatment begins.

body.heading: MHP for women
paragraphs: There are various methods for placing hair pigmentation. These days you can go in any direction, so women can also have this placed. Do you suffer from a parting that keeps getting wider? Or a receding hairline as a woman, where some hair is still visible? Then we can create a fuller look by placing small pixels through the natural hairs.

Micro scalp pigmentation for women is placed with the same technique, only we use a different fill than with men. We look at what suits you. A consultation is therefore always important before we schedule a treatment.

paragraphs: Good preparation ensures an optimal and long-lasting result. Below are the main points of attention in the week before your treatment:
checklist: Make sure the scalp is healthy and not burnt or irritated
Avoid tanning beds and prolonged exposure to the sun
Do not use scrubs or peels on the scalp
Come to your appointment with a clean, washed scalp
Always follow the personal instructions you receive at your consultation

body.heading: What is laser hair removal?
paragraphs: In laser hair removal, the hair root is treated with targeted light energy. The pigment in the hair absorbs that energy, disabling the hair root and reducing hair growth in that spot.

Because hairs are in different growth phases, several sessions are needed: only hairs in the active growth phase respond to the treatment. During the consultation, we discuss how many sessions are realistic in your situation.

body.heading: Benefits of laser hair removal

body.heading: PMU Eyebrow Aftercare: Instructions for Beautiful Powder Brows
paragraphs: The right aftercare following a Powder Brows treatment is crucial to let the healing process run smoothly and to achieve the desired end result of full and natural eyebrows.

After a semi-permanent make-up treatment, your eyebrows are vulnerable and more sensitive. You can compare this to a graze. With the right aftercare, you prevent infections, pigment loss and other complications, which is especially important with powder brows aftercare.

body.heading: Permanent Eyebrow Aftercare Day 1 to 9
paragraphs: Follow these aftercare instructions carefully during the first nine days to prevent infections and achieve the best result. The powder brows aftercare in this period is essential for a successful recovery.

body.heading: Day 1–2: Cleaning and caring
checklist: Clean every hour: Gently clean the eyebrows with a damp cotton pad soaked in cooled boiled water. Dab the skin gently, without rubbing.
Applying aftercare ointment: After cleaning, apply a thin layer of aftercare cream with a clean cotton swab.

body.heading: Day 3–9: Keeping dry and protecting
checklist: Avoid water: Keep the eyebrows dry while showering. Use a washcloth to protect the area.
No make-up: Do not use eyebrow make-up or other cosmetics on the treated area until all scabs have disappeared.
Do not remove scabs: Let scabs and flakes come off on their own. Scratching or picking can lead to pigment loss. You naturally want to avoid this!
Clean environment: Sleep on a clean pillowcase and avoid contact with pets or dirt.

body.heading: Aftercare after the First Healing
paragraphs: After about 7–10 days, the scabs have disappeared and the second phase of healing begins. During this period, you can do the following to maintain your results:
checklist: Use sun protection: Protect your eyebrows with a sunscreen of SPF 30 or higher.
Schedule a touch-up: After 6–8 weeks, you come back for a follow-up treatment to fill in light spots and perfect the colour.
Stay careful: Even after full healing, the skin remains sensitive. Avoid harsh cleansing products and keep protecting your eyebrows against UV radiation.

checklist: Week 1: The eyebrows heal superficially and scabs gradually fall off.

Week 6–8: The colour has fully stabilised. This is the moment for a touch-up treatment.

items.q: What Happens after a PMU Eyebrow Treatment?
items.a: After a PMU eyebrow treatment, you can expect the following reactions: Intense colour: Immediately after the treatment, the eyebrows look darker than the final result. This is normal and the colour will become softer and more natural during the healing process. Scabs: After a few days, small scabs may form. It is important to leave these alone and not pull them off. Pigment loss: During the first healing of your powder brows, it may seem as if pigment has disappeared. This is a normal process; the pigment gradually becomes visible again in the following weeks. Slight redness or swelling: This may occur after the treatment, but disappears within 24 to 48 hours.

items.q: What Should you Avoid after a PMU Eyebrow Treatment?
items.a: To maintain the results of your Powder Brows, avoid the following things. These steps are among the most important aspects of powder brows aftercare: Sweat and heat: Do not exercise for 5 days. Sweat contains salts that can reject pigment. Avoid saunas, steam baths, swimming pools and other humid spaces for 2 weeks. UV radiation: Do not expose your eyebrows to direct sunlight or tanning beds for 4 weeks. After healing, use an SPF 30+ cream to protect the pigmentation. Aggressive products: Do not use creams or tonics with Retinol, Glycolic acid, Salicylic acid or other aggressive ingredients. Facial treatments: Avoid facial treatments, chemical peels, Botox or microdermabrasion for 4 weeks. Scratching or rubbing: Leave scabs alone. Pulling them off can cause infections, scars or uneven pigment.

items.q: 1. How long does the healing of PMU eyebrows take?
items.a: The superficial healing takes 7–10 days. The full healing process, including colour stabilisation, can take up to 8 weeks.

items.q: 2. Can I get my eyebrows wet after the treatment?
items.a: No, keep the treated area dry for at least 7 days. While showering, use a washcloth to protect your eyebrows from water.

items.q: 3. What should I do if scabs form?
items.a: Let the scabs come off on their own. Do not scratch or pull them off, as this can cause pigment loss or scars.

items.q: 4. When can I use make-up on my eyebrows again?
items.a: Only use make-up on your eyebrows after all scabs have fallen off and the skin has fully healed. This usually takes 10 days.

items.q: 5. Why should I schedule a touch-up?
items.a: A touch-up after 6–8 weeks ensures that light spots are filled in and the colour and shape of your eyebrows are perfected.

body.heading: PMU Lip Aftercare: Instructions for an Optimal Result
paragraphs: You can compare new permanent make-up to a graze. The right aftercare of your PMU lips is crucial to let the healing process run well and to achieve a beautiful end result. After a semi-permanent make-up treatment, your lips are vulnerable and more sensitive.
By following the aftercare instructions precisely, you prevent infections and pigment loss and ensure that your lips look beautiful for a long time.

body.heading: Permanent Lip Aftercare Day 1 to 9
paragraphs: To ensure that your lips heal optimally and retain their pigment, follow these aftercare instructions during the first nine days:
Use the ointment you received from your practitioner. Apply it carefully with a clean cotton swab to keep your lips hydrated. Avoid petroleum jelly or other products that are not recommended.
checklist: Avoid water, saliva, drinks and other liquids on the treated skin during the first three days.
Use a straw to drink and prevent contact between your lips and moisture.
PMU lips are an open wound and susceptible to infections. Do not touch the treated skin with your hands.
If you apply an aftercare cream, do so with a clean cotton swab.
Do not sleep on your face; this prevents scabs from falling off too soon. Also use a clean pillowcase to prevent infections.
Let scabs come off on their own. Do not scratch or pull them off; this can cause pigment loss and scars.
Do not use lipstick, lip gloss or other lip products until the lips are fully healed and all scabs have fallen off.
Avoid aggressive products with ingredients such as retinol, glycolic acid or salicylic acid.
Do not expose your lips to direct sunlight, tanning beds, saunas or steam baths for at least four weeks.
Do not exercise for 5 days. Your sweat contains salts that can reject the pigment.
After healing, you can use a lip balm with SPF to protect the pigmentation.
Do not eat spicy, sour or extremely hot food that can irritate the sensitive skin.
Avoid alcohol and caffeine in the first hours after the treatment.

body.heading: Aftercare after the first healing
paragraphs: After 1 week, the scabs are usually fully healed, but this can still take about 9 days. After the first healing phase, you can take extra steps to maintain the results of your PMU lips:
checklist: Use sun protection: Protect your lips with a balm that contains SPF 30 or higher to prevent fading from UV radiation.
Schedule a touch-up: Schedule a follow-up treatment 6–8 weeks after the first session to perfect the colour and shape of your lips.
Consider annual maintenance treatments: An annual touch-up is recommended to keep your lips beautiful for a long time.

body.heading: Healing Time for PMU Lips
checklist: The first healing takes 5–7 days, during which the scabs come off on their own.
During the second week, the colour may temporarily look faded, but it returns after 3–4 weeks.
The full healing, including colour stabilisation, takes 6–8 weeks.

body.heading: PMU Eyeliner Aftercare: Instructions for an Optimal Result
paragraphs: It is very important that you provide the right aftercare for your eyeliner, also known as infralash. For a beautiful and long-lasting result, it is important that the healing runs as well as possible.

After a semi-permanent make-up treatment, your skin is vulnerable and recovering. With good aftercare, you can easily prevent infections and pigment loss. By following the right steps, you ensure that the pigment adheres well and your eyeliner looks radiant for a long time.

body.heading: Permanent Eyeliner Aftercare Day 1 to 9
paragraphs: You naturally want to keep your fresh permanent eyeliner or infralash beautiful for as long as possible. Therefore, follow these aftercare instructions carefully during the first 9 days.
Avoid aggressive products: Do not use creams or cleansing products with ingredients such as Retinol, Glycolic acid or Salicylic acid. These can disrupt the healing process.
checklist: Keep the skin dry:
Avoid water, sweat and other liquids on the treated skin.
While showering, use a washcloth to keep your eyes dry. If the area does get wet, gently dab it dry with a clean tissue (do not rub!).
Do not touch the skin: Your PMU eyeliner is an open wound and susceptible to infections. Do not touch the treated area with your hands.
No make-up: Do not use eye make-up, such as mascara or eyeliner, until the scabs are fully healed. Make-up can irritate the skin and cause infections.
Leave scabs alone: Let scabs come off naturally. Scratching or picking can cause scars, pigment loss and delayed healing.
No UV radiation or heat: Avoid exposure to the sun, tanning beds, saunas and steam baths for the first 4 weeks. UV radiation can affect the pigment.
No contact lenses: Do not wear contact lenses in the first week after the treatment to prevent irritation.
Hygiene is important: Do not sleep on your face to prevent scabs from coming off. Use a clean pillowcase to prevent infections.

body.heading: Aftercare after the first healing
paragraphs: After 1 week, the scabs are usually fully healed, but this can still take about 9 days. There are also a few extra tips to keep your PMU eyeliner beautiful for longer:
checklist: Sun protection: Always use a sunscreen with SPF 30+ to protect the pigment against UV radiation.
Regular touch-up: Schedule a touch-up follow-up treatment 6-8 weeks after the first session to perfect the colour and shape.
Long-term maintenance: For the best result, an annual touch-up is recommended.

items.q: What happens after a PMU Eyeliner Treatment?
items.a: If you have had a permanent eyeliner or infralash treatment, there are a number of things you can expect. Slight swelling and/or redness: Your eyelids may be somewhat swollen and red immediately after the treatment. This is normal and decreases within 24 hours. Intense colour: The eyeliner may look darker and more intense in the first few days. After a week, the colour will become softer and more natural. Scabs: Small scabs may form during the healing process. It is crucial not to remove these and not to touch them, as this can lead to pigment loss and infections.

items.q: 1. How long does the healing of PMU eyeliner take?
items.a: The first healing of permanent make-up eyeliner takes 7-10 days, but the skin continues to stabilise over several weeks. After a month, the end result is fully visible.

items.q: 2. Can I shower after my PMU eyeliner treatment?
items.a: Yes, but make sure the eyeliner does not get wet. Protect the area with a washcloth and avoid direct contact with water.

items.q: 3. What should I do if I have scabs?
items.a: Let scabs come off on their own and do not touch them. Scratching off scabs can cause pigment loss and scars.

items.q: 4. When can I wear mascara after permanent make-up?
items.a: After an infralash treatment, you can apply mascara again after 10 days.

body.heading: Microblading: Why we choose Ombré Powder Brows
paragraphs: Microblading has been a popular choice for years for people looking for full, crisp eyebrows. This technique sounds ideal, but unfortunately it also comes with considerable disadvantages and risks.

At IZZI Beauty, we therefore do not offer microblading. Instead, we have chosen Ombré powder brows, a safe and long-lasting semi-permanent make-up (PMU) method that takes your eyebrows to a higher level. This makes it a better and safe choice without risk.

During a free consultation without obligation for a permanent make-up treatment, we discuss your wishes. You are under no obligation. Schedule a consultation now and discover the options for your brows!

items.q: What is Microblading?
items.a: Microblading is a form of semi-permanent make-up carried out with a manual blade. This blade makes small cuts in the skin into which pigment is applied. The aim is to mimic hairs and thus create a natural look. Despite the promises of microblading, this technique comes with many risks. This is also the reason why we do not support this treatment and advise our customers to choose the right treatment to still get perfect eyebrows!

items.q: 1. Risk of scars

items.q: 2. Not suitable for every skin
items.a: Microblading is only suitable for people with normal or dry skin. Do you have oily skin, mature skin or sensitive skin? Then microblading can fade quickly, look unnatural or cause problems during the healing process.

items.q: 3. Limited repeatability
items.a: Microblading can often only be carried out once or twice in your life. Every time you have the skin cut again, you increase the risk of developing scars and skin damage. This means that the technique is not suitable for long-term maintenance.

items.q: 4. Pain and discomfort
items.a: The microblading technique involves cutting into the skin, which can be painful, both during the treatment and during the healing process. Many customers also report that the skin needs a long time to recover, especially when the cuts are made deeper.

items.q: 5. Fading and pigment change
items.a: Although microblading is often presented as a semi-permanent solution, the lines fade quickly and the pigment can change colour (for example to blue or red). As a result, your eyebrows can look unnatural over time.

items.q: 6. Limited creativity
items.a: With microblading, the hairs may not be placed too close together or crossed, because this causes too much trauma to the skin. As a result, the results are limited in style and creativity.

It is strongly advised against exercising during the first 7-10 days after your treatment. Sweat can disrupt the healing and cause the pigment to be absorbed unevenly into the skin.

items.q: What are Powder Brows?

Why we choose Powder Brows: Skin-friendly: Because no cuts are made, the skin remains completely intact. This minimises the risk of scars. items.q: What is Microblading?

With Microblading, pigment is applied deep into the upper layer of skin by means of superficial cuts. The result looks like hairstrokes.
